shadcn/no-restyle.checks: Classes passed to design-system components from outside, beyond what the allow list and the component's contract permit.
shadcn/no-restyle.intended_fix: Use an existing variant or size of the component. Add a new variant in the component file only if the design explicitly calls for it. Layout classes may go on the component or a parent.

shadcn/no-raw-colors.checks: Raw Tailwind palette colors (bg-pink-500), color tokens the theme does not declare, and literal colors in SVG attributes.
shadcn/no-raw-colors.intended_fix: Use a color token declared in the theme, or declare a new token in the theme file.

shadcn/no-arbitrary-values.checks: Arbitrary values such as p-[13px] or rounded-[10px], even when an equivalent token or scale step exists.
shadcn/no-arbitrary-values.intended_fix: Use the equivalent theme token or scale step, snapping to the nearest one.

shadcn/no-inline-styles.checks: Ordinary inline style properties, hardcoded colors in custom properties, unreadable style objects, and <style> elements.
shadcn/no-inline-styles.intended_fix: Use classes. Pass dynamic values through CSS custom properties that reference theme variables.

shadcn/no-unknown-classes.checks: Class names the project's Tailwind v4 setup cannot generate, such as typos.
shadcn/no-unknown-classes.intended_fix: Fix the spelling or use a class Tailwind generates.

shadcn/require-static-classes.checks: Class values on components built from values the linter cannot read.
shadcn/require-static-classes.intended_fix: Use static strings or conditional choices between complete class names.
